verdict.rationale: Angular's own docs tout an 'opinionated' platform with signals, DI, and TypeScript, but hands-on community reports concretely contradict the claim of minimal new concepts: template syntax like ngFor is 'weird' and not standard HTML (angular-comm-3, angular-comm-15), and contributors note the need to learn TypeScript specifically (angular-comm-12). Missing for 10: first-party or independent evidence showing components can be authored in plain HTML/CSS/JS without learning Angular-specific template directives, DI, or TypeScript.
